label: Best possible (perfect hindsight)

metrics.scope: all batteries (exact per-kWh scaling), not a sample
metrics.method: Per-day LP (HiGHS) with perfect knowledge of each day's real-time prices at 15-minute settlement resolution, each day ending at the charge level it started at. Exact for all 20,000 batteries by scaling: revenue = capacity x F(power/capacity), F solved at 16 power-to-capacity ratios from 0.25 to 1 and interpolated (interpolation bounds within 0.092%).
metrics.headline: uncapped
metrics.why_uncapped: The simulated batteries have no cycle limit or wear cost, and neither do the strategies, so only the uncapped plan bounds what any strategy could earn under the same rules. The one-cycle-a-day figure is a reference for warranty-limited operation.
